name: Corvid Ledger availability commitment (authored)
text:
The service provider under this agreement is Corvid Data Cooperative.
This contract is identified as CDC-SLA-07.
This service level agreement is valid from 2026-03-01 through 2027-02-28.
Availability is measured over each full calendar month in UTC.
The availability commitment covers the Corvid Ledger product on the Archive plan.
| Monthly availability below | Service credit |
| --- | --- |
| 99.9% | 5% |
| 99% | 20% |
Credit requests must be received within 45 calendar days after the end of each calendar month.
Credits are calculated as a percentage of the affected monthly fees and are applied to a future invoice.
